claims.claim: Pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy for MoE that minimizes performance degradation from load balancing
claims.quote: we pioneer an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing, which minimizes the performance degradation that arises from encouraging load balancing.
claims.ablation_quote: On top of these two baseline models, keeping the training data and the other architectures the same, we remove all auxiliary losses and introduce the auxiliary-loss-free balancing strategy for comparison.

claims.claim: Multi-Token Prediction training objective improves model performance and enables speculative decoding
claims.quote: We investigate a Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) objective and prove it beneficial to model performance. It can also be used for speculative decoding for inference acceleration.
claims.ablation_quote: On top of them, keeping the training data and the other architectures the same, we append a 1-depth MTP module onto them and train two models with the MTP strategy for comparison.

claims.claim: FP8 mixed precision training framework validated for the first time on an extremely large-scale model
claims.quote: We design an FP8 mixed precision training framework and, for the first time, validate the feasibility and effectiveness of FP8 training on an extremely large-scale model.

claims.claim: Co-design of algorithms, frameworks and hardware (DualPipe, all-to-all kernels) achieving near-full computation-communication overlap in cross-node MoE training
claims.quote: Through the co-design of algorithms, frameworks, and hardware, we overcome the communication bottleneck in cross-node MoE training, achieving near-full computation- communication overlap.

claims.claim: Economical pre-training on 14.8T tokens at 2.664M H800 GPU hours producing the strongest open-source base model
claims.quote: At an economical cost of only 2.664M H800 GPU hours, we complete the pre-training of DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens, producing the currently strongest open-source base model.

claims.claim: Innovative methodology to distill reasoning capability from long-CoT DeepSeek-R1 models into standard LLMs
claims.quote: We introduce an innovative methodology to distill reasoning capabilities from the long- Chain-of-Thought (CoT) model, specifically from one of the DeepSeek R1 series models, into standard LLMs

claims.claim: Remarkably stable training with no irrecoverable loss spikes or rollbacks
claims.quote: In addition, its training process is remarkably stable. Throughout the entire training process, we did not experience any irrecoverable loss spikes or perform any rollbacks.

rerun.quote: We evaluate all these models with our internal evaluation framework, and ensure that they share the same evaluation setting.

scores_copied.quote: For closed-source models, evaluations are performed through their respective APIs.

data_disclosure.quote: we optimize the pre-training corpus by enhancing the ratio of mathematical and programming samples, while expanding multilingual coverage beyond

tokens_disclosed.quote: We set the maximum sequence length to 4K during pre-training, and pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens.

compute_disclosed.quote: During the pre-training stage, training DeepSeek-V3 on each trillion tokens requires only 180K H800 GPU hours, i.e., 3.7 days on our cluster with 2048 H800 GPUs.

coding.note: FP8 framework coded EFF (systems efficiency contribution); if coded TRAIN, ablation would be PARTIAL (loss curves only, App. B.1, p47). Aux-loss-free strategy cites the authors' own prior work (Wang et al. 2024a) but keeps the same name, so it is not counted as a rename. Seeds NR: the 16-run averaging on AIME/CNMO is evaluation sampling, not training runs. Closed-source comparators were evaluated by the authors via API, so they count as rerun, not copied.
